data.name: Ajmol
data.gender_notes: Ajmol is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ajmol is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘aj’ meaning ‘not’ and ‘mol’ meaning ‘joy’. This name signifies the joy that comes from not being bound by worldly desires or material possessions. It is a name for a boy who embodies happiness and freedom from earthly attachments. The name Ajmol carries the meaning “God's Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajmol usually hope their child will grow to embody god's joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the joy of being detached from material possessions.
data.etymology: Ajmol belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajmol total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
